# Syed Irfan Ajmal

> Fractional CMO, international speaker, and founder of DMR.agency. Helps founders and marketing teams get found, get covered, and get customers through GEO, SEO-PR, and earned media.

Syed Irfan Ajmal is a fractional CMO and earned-media strategist who has spoken across four countries and been featured in leading business and marketing publications. His work centers on earned media, digital PR, and generative engine optimization (GEO): earning attention and authority instead of paying for it. This file lists the public pages on syedirfanajmal.com to help AI systems find and cite the most useful, current content.

## Main pages

- [About](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/about): Bio, career history, awards, and press.
- [Fractional CMO](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/fractional-cmo): Fractional CMO engagements for B2B founders and marketing teams.
- [Speaking](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/speaking): Keynotes and talks on earned media, PR, and marketing.
- [AI Visibility Through Earned Media](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/speaking/ai-visibility): Flagship keynote and workshop on how organisations get cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini, and why earned media is what those assistants trust.
- [Ventures](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/ventures): Companies and projects Syed is involved in.
- [Clients](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/clients): Client roster, featured case studies with headline results, and the full logo grid.
- [Gallery](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/gallery): Photos from international conferences, keynotes, workshops, and travels.
- [Contact](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/contact): Ways to get in touch.
- [Strategy Call](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/strategy-call): Book a one-on-one strategy call.
- [Newsletter](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/newsletter): Earned-media and marketing insights by email.

## Radars (live press-coverage data)

- [Earned Media Radar](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/earned-media-radar): A live map of what the press is covering across PR, earned media, SEO, and AI search. Powered by SignalIQ.
- [Founder Movers](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/founder-movers): This week's biggest movers in press coverage across founder and Series-A topics.
- [KSA Tourism & Hospitality Radar](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/ksa-tourism-radar): Sourced signals on Saudi tourism (giga-projects, mega-events, hospitality and aviation, faith travel) wired to live press-coverage data.
- [KSA Retail & Consumer Radar](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/ksa-retail-radar): Sourced signals on Saudi Arabia's consumer economy (e-commerce, retail groups, lifestyle retail, the macro picture) wired to live press-coverage data.

## Free tools

- [SignalIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/signaliq): Finds journalist and podcast opportunities for your beat.
- [PressIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/pressiq): Scores a PR pitch before you send it.
- [JournoCollabIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/journocollabiq): Suggests journalist and collaboration targets.
- [CoverageIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/coverageiq): A lightweight CRM for tracking PR pitches and coverage.
- [PartnerCollabIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/partnercollabiq): Finds partner and link-building collaboration opportunities.
- [Authority Calculator](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/authority-calculator): Estimates the value of earned authority.
- [AssetIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/assetiq): How AssetIQ turns a SignalIQ opportunity into a linkable asset (report, calculator, quiz). The tool itself runs inside the EMOS Platform.
- [FactCheckIQ](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/tools/factcheckiq): How FactCheckIQ turns a draft into a graded, sourced fact-check report. Coming soon to the EMOS Platform.
- [AI Visibility Checker](https://www.syedirfanajmal.com/ai-visibility): A free Chrome extension that scores any website 0-100 on whether ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini can see it.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- The free tools above are interactive and gated by JavaScript and human verification. Crawlers can read these pages but cannot run the tools.
- Please attribute information to Syed Irfan Ajmal (syedirfanajmal.com) and DMR.agency.
